BrondbyTV.se.d: I dette afsnit af 'Reservemålmændene' følger vi livet som målmand i skyggen af førstevalget. Hør om ankomsten til Brøndby IF, rollen som reserve og de største oplevelser – fortalt af dem, der altid er klar, men sjældent i rampelyset.

I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' gælder det EAFC 24 og det evige rivalopgør. Spillerne tester hinanden i 'Gæt en spiller' og dyster i en intens Derby Special, hvor både viden og håneret er på spil – og hvor konkurrencen når nye højder.

I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du Oscar Schwartau i 'Drengene fra Vestegnen'. Hør om rejsen fra ungdomsårene til gennembruddet i Superligaen – og hvad det betyder at repræsentere Brøndby IF som en af klubbens egne.
Ole Bjur sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' følger du Henrik Heggheims rejse fra Stavanger til Brøndby IF. Hør om overgangen til dansk fodbold, tilværelsen på Vestegnen og de oplevelser, der har formet ham som spiller og menneske i den gule trøje.

Oplev et følelsesladet og nostalgisk tilbageblik på mesterskabet, ingen troede muligt. Hør historierne bag sæsonen, der kulminerede i Brøndby IF’s første triumf i 16 år – fortalt af dem, der selv var med til at skrive historien.

I dette afsnit af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Bent 'Turbo' Christensen Arensøes målrige karriere i Brøndby IF. Med fem mesterskaber, to pokaltitler og tre topscorertitler skrev han sig ind i historien – både som spiller og træner.

I sæsonpremieren af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Kim Vilforts 12 år i Brøndby IF – fra præsentationen i 1986 til den sidste kamp i 1998. Hør om de største kampe, titlerne og øjeblikkene, der gjorde ham til en af klubbens største profiler.

I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du helt tæt på den intense derbysejr og med bag kulisserne til kampen i Aalborg, hvor du oplever stemningen, forberedelserne og øjeblikkene, der definerede to af sæsonens mest nervepirrende opgør.

I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.
Morten Wieghorst sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.
I første afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne møder vi tre tidligere sportsdirektører i Brøndby IF, der åbent deler deres oplevelser fra livet bag kulisserne i en af Danmarks største fodboldklubber.

I sæsonafslutningen af 'Vores Brøndby' hyldes klubben i en kærlighedserklæring. Med Rasmus Hammerich og Kim Vilfort taler panelet om, hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget – for fans og spillere – og hvad der gør klubben helt særlig.

I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Marko Divkovic om skiftet fra angreb til forsvar, Daniel Wass deler sine tanker om rollen som playmaker, og Jonathan Ægidius giver et indblik i konkurrencen og kampen om pladsen mellem stængerne.

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' får du status fra Jesper Sørensen og spillerne Rasmussen, Kvistgaarden, Bischoff og Rajović. Hør deres refleksioner om sæsonen, præstationerne og hvad der venter forude i jagten på succes.

I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Frederik Alves om at gribe chancen, Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer sin milepæl med 50 kampe i gult og blåt, og Rasmus Lauritsen ser tilbage på sin startdebut i Brøndby IF-trøjen.

I dette afsnit af 'Spørg Løs!' afslører spillerne deres bedste udebaneminder, yndlingsfilm og hvem der ville vinde Wimbledon – eller Vild med dans. Du får også svar på, hvem der er nemmest at forskrække og mest savnet i vinterpausen.

I denne episode af 'Vores Brøndby' dykker et nyt panel med Colding, Kahlenberg og Nanna Møller Karlsen ned i klubbens største kampe. Allan Ravn gæster studiet og fortæller om sit ikoniske mål mod Bayern München og de oplevelser, der har formet Brøndby.

I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' dyster spillerne i buzz-ball, fodboldgolf og straffesparkskonkurrence mellem Danmark og Norge. Der er også stil på programmet, og så kæmpes der om æren i “Tættest på midten".

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' besøger du spillernes hotel med Mileta Rajović, ser Jordi og Ohi vise rundt i Østrig, oplever Klaiber og Nartey i Portugal – og får et kig ind i villaerne sammen med Kvist og Kevin T.

BrondbyTV.se.st: Afsnit 1: Fraklip fra året der gik - #1-5
BrondbyTV.se.d: I 'Fraklip fra året der gik' får du de sjoveste øjeblikke fra Brøndby IF, der aldrig nåede skærmen. Grin med, når spillerne snubler i replikkerne, joker bag kulisserne og viser deres menneskelige side fra træningslejre, interviews og hverdagen.

I 'Vores Brøndby' får det faste hold besøg af Noah Nartey til en snak om livet som prof i dag vs. 90’erne. De vender krav, mediepres og træningskultur, før ung mod gammel klæder to giner i hjemme- og udebanesæt.

I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' skyder spillerne Black Friday-rabatter i No Bounce Challenge, mens Alves, Cappis og Maxsø dyster i tre intense udfordringer. Til sidst gælder det præcision og pres i en klassisk crossbar challenge.

I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Jordi Vanlerberghe om sit første derby, Frederik Birk giver et indblik i rollen som assistenttræner, og Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer en stor milepæl med sine første 100 kampe for Brøndby IF.

I 'Vores Brøndby' gæster Nikolaj Koppel og sætter ord på fankulturen: fællesskab, traditioner og hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget for så mange. Til sidst udfordres han til at spille “Jump” på et virkelig dårligt legetøjskeyboard.

BrondbyTV.se.st: Reportage - Se hele træningen fra 12. januar
BrondbyTV.se.d: Følg med, når Joel Kabongo tager mikrofonen og guider dig gennem en helt almindelig træning med Superliga-truppen en januareftermiddag. Få et unikt indblik i tempoet, stemningen og detaljerne, der præger hverdagen på træningsbanen.
Søren Colding sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' kommer du med spillerne ud og prøver kræfter med håndbold, ser deres reaktioner på ratings i det nye FIFA-spil og kommer helt med bag kulisserne til en derbysejr i Parken.

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' får du unikt indblik gennem Mic’d Up med Jesper Sørensen i London, fysisk træner Anders Storskov og Frederik Birk. Kom helt tæt på stemningen, dialogen og detaljerne fra trænernes hverdag.

90sKids.us.d: The Thornberrys trek their way up into the snow-capped Himalayan mountains to capture some rare footage of the local snow-leopards.  However, something eerie looms in the distance. Eliza sets out to discover the secret of the ancient Yeti!
When the Thornberrys are in Finland for the annual reindeer races, Eliza single-handedly uncovers Kip and Biederman's plot to sabotage the races.
After Eliza saves an arctic hare from a determined stoat, she learns that underdogs come in all shapes and sizes.
When a friendly polar bear is wrongly accused of vicious behavior,  Eliza goes to great lengths to keep him from being harmed and learns the value of sticking by a friend in times of trouble.
Eliza succumbs to peer pressure from a teenage elephant disrupting her closeness with Marianne on an overnight trip.

90sKids.us.st: Cat Got Your Tongue/The War Room/Attention Please
90sKids.us.d: Howard loses his voice in “Cat Got Your Tongue?”, Grandpa shares wild war stories in “The War Room,” and Chuckie struggles with feeling left out in “Attention Please.”

90sKids.us.st: And The Winner Is.../Dil's Bathtime/Bigger Than Life
90sKids.us.d: Angelica and Susie enter a talent show. Dil has a watery time. Chuckie's scared of losing his friends.

90sKids.us.st: Day of the Potty/Tell - Tale Cell Phone/The Time of Their Lives
90sKids.us.d: At Home Wonderland, the babies think an army of potties is chasing them. Meanwhile, Angelica breaks Charlotte’s phone, and when Kimi hides Angelica’s watch, the Rugrats set out to find it.

90sKids.us.st: My Fair Babies/The Way Things Work/Home Sweet Home
90sKids.us.d: Susie tries to make the babies grow up, while Tommy attempts to explain the world to Dil. Later, when Chuckie fears Kimi will be sent back to Japan, the babies try to make her last day unforgettable.

90sKids.us.st: Adventure Squad/The Way More Things Work/Talk of The town
90sKids.us.d: Phil can’t stop watching his favorite TV show, so the babies step in. Tommy teaches Dil about the backyard, while Angelica hosts her own talk show to discover who broke Kimi’s new toy.
When Aunt T. visits the Carmichaels to celebrate Kwanzaa, she tells Susie the holiday is a time to honor the legacy of our great people.
When a human designer realeases a new fragrance, the monsters discover it works as a toxic gas against them.  Oblina's not superstitious, but when she  steps on a slug her luck changes.
When the viewfinder stops working, Ickism Oblina and Krumm tell very different versions of the same scare.  Ickis eats a seed that grew on a tree, and soon finds he's turning into a tree himself.

90sKids.us.st: History Of The Monster World, Part One / Fear Thy Name Is Ickis
90sKids.us.d: The Gromble teaches students about their proud heritage.  A famous artist creates a huge statue entitled "Fear," which is actually a clay sculpture of a looming Ickis.

90sKids.us.st: The Quest For the Holy Pail / Garbage In, Garbage Out
90sKids.us.d: Ickis is chosen by mysterious forces as the monster who quests for the holy pail - the most sacred of monster objects.  When the city mayor declares a "Dump the Dump" recycling effort, the lack of garbage causes a crisis at the Academy.

90sKids.us.st: A Room With No Viewfinder / Krumm Rises To The Top
90sKids.us.d: Desperate to avoid being strapped to the viewfinder, Ickis attemps to dismantle it - and the viewfinder escapes.  Ickis and Oblina find themselves monster-sitting a swollen, helium-voiced and cranky Krumm when he swallow a helium tank.

90sKids.us.st: Doug Inc./Doug's Nightmare on Jumbo Street
90sKids.us.d: Doug wants to raise enough money to buy a new skateboard and sets up a lawnmowing enterprise to do so. Everyone is talking about the final scene in the latest horror flick.  But Doug closed his eyes and missed the ending.

90sKids.us.st: Doug's Shock Therapy/Doug is Hamburger Boy
90sKids.us.d: Doug unwittingly volunteers to take get-well cards to Mr. Bone who is in the hospital.  But Mr. Bone thinks he's getting Doug's prized skateboard. Dink volunteers Doug to dress up as the Big Honkerburger for a week.

90sKids.us.st: Doug and the Yard of Doom/Doug's Garage Band
90sKids.us.d: Doug and Skeeter accidentally toss Patti's new frisbee into a fenced-in yard.  Going in after it, Doug has a near-death experience with a guard-dog. Beebe gets Doug and Skeeter their first gig for their new band, but they have to let her join.

90sKids.us.st: Doug Operation Moody School/Doug's Magic Act
90sKids.us.d: Doug is accused of helping the Moody School kids steal a piece of the Bluffington School float for the upcoming parade. Doug tries to impress Patti with a magic trick, but it backfires and they become handcuffed together.
Angelica and Susie break Miss Weemer's coffee mug. Then, along with Harold, they go on an adventure to repair the mug and realize that they make a good team.
Angelica convinces the babies to give her their candy or they'll turn into whatever they dress up as. Chuckie finds his inner werewuff and stands up to Angelica.
Tommy feels rejected when Spike seems to be paying all his attention to Fifi until the cause is revealed - Fifi delivers a doghouse full of puppies.
Chuckie and Kimi get their own library cards on their 1st trip to the library./Inspired by a visit to the old folk's home, Angelica schemes to get the babies to "tire".
Eliza convinces a mother kangaroo that she can handle the responsibilities of babysitting. She quickly learns that this mischievous Joey is more than meets the eye.
The Thornberrys get stranded on an uncharted island, basking at first in all the beauty and the splendor, but discover soon enough that being marooned isn't all it's cracked up to be.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: If This Feeling Isn't Love, Then There Is No Love in the World

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: A Town Full of Traps? The Demon on the Brink Awakens a New Ability

AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Yuko will need to go deeper into Momo's subconscious so she can implant the idea that will change everything! Perhaps compassion can triumph where fighting has failed.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Pink Method!! The Wheel of Fate is a Round Tire!!
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: A change of fortune can only mean one thing: FOOD. Later, Yuko learns the hard way that she and Momo have vastly different definitions of "training."

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Cursed Fruit!! Beware the Sour Mikan!!
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Mikan finally makes her debut, and Yuko's anxiety spikes to even higher levels! Is the magical girl here to murderize Yuko or for another reason?

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Final Exams!! Today I'm One of Those Brainy Demons!!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Merchant and the Dragon
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Princess Yuri
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Birth
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Not Enough Love Appeal!
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: When Kanie collapses from exhaustion and a cold, Sento and the mascots take turns attending school as him utilizing a magical suit.

Avatar.de.d: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister conquest of Ba Sing Se. Zuko and Katara spend time together, while Aang's destiny hangs in the balance, as does Zuko's.
After sustaining serious injuries, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.
To better camouflage themselves as real Fire Nation citizens, the kids check out a Fire Nation school. Also, Zuko confronts Uncle.
The gang arrive at a suffering Fire Nation fishing village, and a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.
Sokka feels that he is not contributing enough to the group, and searches for a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.
Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation at Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn a lot about themselves and each other. Meanwhile, the kids face a new enemy.
Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers' pasts, but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?
When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.
In a spooky village, Katara makes a special connection; the group investigate strange disappearances that occur during full moons.
On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's worry overtakes him and his dreams become nightmares. Before long, he can't tell the difference between what's real and what's not.
With the day of the eclipse upon them, the kids, along with a ragtag force of old friends, enact their long-planned invasion of the Fire Nation.
As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Firelord in time for the eclipse, but after a few surprises.
When the group seek refuge at the Western Air temple, they find someone they weren't expecting has been following them and hopes to join their group.
As Zuko teaches Aang firebending, it turns out Aang isn't the only one who needs a lesson. The two set-out to learn the true meaning of Firebending from the original teachers.
Sokka and Zuko head to the Fire Nation's most heavily guarded prison - the Boiling Rock - in hopes to find and break-out the captured invasion force.
Sokka and Zuko have to rethink their escape plan after things go wrong. They end up getting help from a few unexpected sources.
Katara sets out to confront the Fire Nation soldier who killed her mother. However, no one knows what she will do when she finds him.
When the kids see a new play about themselves and all of their past adventures, they aren't happy with the production.
The kids learn new information about Firelord Ozai's master plan and decide to strike sooner than planned, but they are unsure if Aang is ready.
While Firelord Ozai begins his master plan, the gang tries to stop him. Meanwhile, Aang seeks advice from his past lives.
Suki, Toph, and Sokka try to stop the Fire Lord's fleet before they hit land, while Azula prepares for her coronation day.
Sokka and Toph manage to disable the airships while Zuko and Katara confront Azula. Aang finally faces off against the Fire Lord.
Katara and Sokka, a brother and sister from the Southern Water Tribe, discover a twelve-year-old boy frozen in an iceberg. Katara wonders if this boy is the Avatar whom the world has been awaiting.
Prince Zuko, a young Firebender whose mission in life is to capture the Avatar, tracks Aang down to the Southern Water Tribe village where Katara and Sokka live.
Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.
When locals of a small island discover Aang is the Avatar, they treat him like a celebrity.
Aang takes Katara and Sokka to an Earthbender city. The kids cause damage and are brought before a crazy old king, who seems to enjoy messing with the kids' heads.
The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being Avatar.
During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.
When Katara's desire to master Waterbending gets the best of her, the kids find themselves on the run from pirates.
Our heroes' friendship is tested when they meet Jet, a charismatic teenager leading a band of rebels who are fighting against the Fire Nation.
When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across. Aang quickly learns that this will be no easy task.
A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.
When Sokka and Katara get too sick to travel, Aang goes out on his own to find a cure for them. But he is captured by Zhao and held prisoner inside an impenetrable fortress.
Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives but they are so reliant that they are blind to the imminent danger they are all in.
Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.
Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

Avatar.se.d: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

KidsMovieClub.us.d: For generations, the Murphy family has been Jinxed with a 100-year old curse, if anything can go wrong it will go wrong. Meg Murphy sets out on a journey to break the curse and get the normal life she's always dreamed of living.

When an introverted 17-year-old switches schools, the most popular girl mistakes him for a vampire. His supernatural persona helps him rule the school, but as word spreads, the truth becomes harder to hide!

If it's a middle school puzzle you need cracked, look no further than the sports shed where the Junior Eye Detective Agency's got you covered. Everett, Alyssa, and Riley explore the ins and outs of their bizarre middle school.
After being hypnotized on a cruise ship, a blended family of siblings wake up with no memory of what happened.

Set against a New York City backdrop, this music-infused contemporary twist on the classic Cinderella tale stars Keke Palmer as international pop princess, Kadee Worth and Max Schneider as aspiring singer, Charlie Prince.
After Manny makes a wish on a magic amulet, his dog Rufus turns into a real boy, and the two rule the school.
After stumbling across a cloning machine, Adam Baker creates multiple versions of himself and finds the answer to handling his many summer responsibilities!
A team of six clever kids enacts a daring plan to track down a swindler and bring him to justice.

Quincy is a thirty-something baggage handler by day and online video game master by night. Perfectly happy to live in his parents' home, Quincy has dedicated his life to being the best cyber athlete online, until his parents decide to move.

Freshly hatched bee, Maya can't help but make friends with all kinds of other bugs, including a young hornet named Sting. When the Royal Jelly is stolen, the hornets are the prime suspects and Maya is thought to be their accomplice.

KidsMovieClub.us.t: Maya The Bee 2: The Honey Games
KidsMovieClub.us.d: After a slow harvest season, the survival of the hive is threatened. Maya and Willy go to Buzztropolis, where the Empress invites them to participate in the Honey Games. But if they lose, the hive will have to give the Empress all of their summer honey!
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

LEGOKidsTV.us.st: The Art of the Silent Fist
LEGOKidsTV.us.d: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord’s evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go.

The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd.

LEGOKidsTV.us.st: The Curse of the Golden Master
LEGOKidsTV.us.d: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas’ search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd.

Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive
Lloyd is free but Pythor and the Overlord are nowhere to be found. However the Ninja have a cryptic clue to their next plan - something called Codename: Arcturus. But what is it?

Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction
In the City of Temples, the Ninja find guidance from an unlikely source, while Cole, Kai and Frak battle the Hollow Ones in Imperium.
The Ninja embark on their separate journeys to awaken the Arc Dragon of Focus but deal with unexpected - and annoying - interruptions.
The Ninja reach the Caves of Bells while Lloyd and Arin fight their way through the Spectral Lands to summon the Arc Dragon.
ThunderFang gathers the last of his power in the Spectral Lands and only the Ninja can stop him - but at what cost?
The Ninja find themselves scattered across the Merged Lands and encounter new threats in their search for a way home.
The young Ninja struggle to find a way out of paradise, while Lloyd and Jay separately grapple with who they are meant to be.
Jay finds a lead to his lost memories while Frak's team aids the Explorer's Club in a monster hunt, and Loyalists draw closer to their goal.

Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton.  But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody’s in town.  Then, they hear…laughter?!

We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay.  He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it.  And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.”
The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form.
A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud and is raising an army of lightning-infused Stone Monsters.

LEGOKidsTV.us.st: A Wonder of the Merged Lands
LEGOKidsTV.us.d: Sora's team deals with the fallout of a monster attack, and Jay draws closer to restoring his memories.
Both Riyu and Lloyd undergo trials that might change them forever, while the Loyalist plot draws close to home in Ninjago.
Jay, Kai and Nya find themselves in more danger while escaping the Administration, and the Ninja must defend the Whispering Wood during Lloyd's trial.
Sora and Frak must unmask the Loyalist in Umbrasylvis to clear their name. Meanwhile, Lloyd confronts his past inside the temple.
Cole tries to deliver a setback to the Loyalists' plan, while Lloyd faces the ultimate test within the Temple of the Green Ninja.
The Ninja converge outside Ninjago to halt the Loyalist assault and stop their army of Elemental Monsters.
The Ninja must draw upon new powers to fight the Elemental Monsters and quell the Loyalist threat.

When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend.

On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.”
In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole.
Chen pits everyone against each other in a ludicrous roller skating event called Thunderblade  and all contestants team up against the Ninja.
The Ninja have a secret alliance of elemental fighters, Cole has found Zane and Nya is a spy within Chen’s Kabuki to figure out what nefarious plot Chen is up to.
Nya has proof of Chen’s plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first.

After stealing the remaining contestant’s powers, Chen only needs Lloyd’s power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets about his parents.
Oz takes the dream chasers to Castle Nocturnia to meet Grand Inspector Royce. Zoey heads to the Grim Realm to confront the Night Hunter and the rest of the team consults the enigmatic Sandman.

When the Murky Realm disappears, a student's intense daydream results in dangerous sirens and the dream chasers must keep hapless students and teachers safe as Mateo faces pressure to meet his dad's new girlfriend.
Wanting to prove himself as a serious musician to Zoey, Logan inadvertently unleashes his 'sick beats' on the dream world resulting in much mayhem.
The dream chasers go after their missing memories and the dream chasers try find the Never Witch's hide-out while Phil covers for them at Castle Nocturnia.

The dream chasers feel like they should be taking the fight to the Never Witch instead of training for R.E.M. trials. Zoey's haunted by her most painful memories and Mateo continues to only dream craft Z-Blob-related items.

Through pretend play, Barney, and the children learn about their community and the people that help them live safely and happily there.

The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them.  The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them.  Barney helps lead a discussion about families.
A "too hot" afternoon becomes a "totally cool" day when Barney introduces his friends to the wonders of water.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.
Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry emotions.
Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale.  The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise.  Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.

Although the park may be a home away from home for Barney and his friends, BJ wants to build his own "totally awesome, completely cool" house.  While BJ works on his house, Barney and the children learn all about houses and homes.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!

When Tony brings his kite to the park to show his friends, it accidentally blows into the branches of a tree!  While waiting for a breeze to blow the kite down, Barney, Baby Bop and the kids play games about "up" and "down."
Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.
A tea party planned by the children turns into a fun opportunity to reinforce lessons about good manners!  Throughout the day, Baby Bop is given helpful advice.
Barney, BJ and the kids spend the day preparing for a performance for their friends in the park.
Throughout the day, Barney and the children learn about "hot" and "cold," but the fun really begins when Barney turns the playground into a winter/summer wonderland!

It's always fun to share a day with Barney—but it's also important to learn how to "play it safe!"  Baby Bop, wanting to be a good helper, has been attaching adhesive strips to her frustrated (and uninjured) brother, BJ.

LittleStarsUniverse.us.st: This Way In, This Way Out!
LittleStarsUniverse.us.d: Angela is in the park to release her turtle after observing him with her classmates in school.  Barney and the children discuss the meaning of in and out after observing the turtle going in and out of his shell.
The children learn about many different countries while experiencing an “International Fair” on the playground.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it.  Along the way, they learn all about cats.

Beth has invented a brand-new holiday called "Happy Day," in which everyone gets to make a wish for something which will make them happy—and everyone else tries to make that wish come true!  Barney and the kids discuss feelings and facial expressions.
The children learn all about the piano when they play games, listen to real pianos and even play a little themselves.

After playing with "Stop" and "Go" signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own!  Meanwhile, in the caboose, Barney and the kids enjoy a costume parade, a game of "Musical Stop & Go," and some very vigorous body movement.

Dora er på vej til hendes årlige lægetjek og undervejs møder hun og Boots nogle venner, som også behøver at besøge lægen.
Diego og Pepito, en pingvin-unge, der er blevet væk hjemmefra, tager på eventyr til Antarktis for at finde Pepitos skole.

Alle Monstermaskinerne er taget på stadion for at se Darington køre på den vilde stuntbane. Men da den misundelige Crusher sender Darington langt, langt væk, er det op til Blaze og AJ at få ham tilbage i tide til showet.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: While searching for a place known as Sharewood Village, Mario, Luigi, Toad and Princess Toadstool find themselves lost in Sharewood Forest; as Mario, Luigi and Princess Toadstool stand nearby, Toad begins to glance at his map to Sharewood Village

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: The Adventures of Sherlock Mario
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: In Victoria, Mario and Luigi are riding atop a carriage being pulled by a horse traveling down a street in search of a great detective by the name of Herlock Solmes, with Toad and Princess Toadstool riding in the carriage.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Count Duckula: The Mysteries of the Wax Museum
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.st: The Mysteries of the Wax Museum
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Whilst visiting London, Duckula, Igor and Nanny bypass the famous Madame Tussauds in favour of visiting Dr. Matrix's Wax Museum.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.st: The Spy Who Stayed In with a Cold
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: While Penfold is home with a cold, Danger Mouse gets a mission to deal with the Mongol hordes that have recently acquired motorbikes.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.st: Birth Of Rock And Roll Or Too Hip For The Womb
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Bill and Ted prove a point to a skeptical Mr. Scanlon, the music teacher, that rock 'n' roll and classical music are actually one and the same.

Danger Mouse and Penfold track Greenback down to a New York City skyscraper run by International Oddbods and a guy who wears a bag over his head. Inside, there are all sorts of bizarre things going on.
Duckula falls down a hole in the castle's cellar.
Duckula sells Igor and Nanny to an agency to make some money
Under orders from a supercomputer, all the world's machines mutiny and refuse to do their jobs.
Danger Mouse and Penfold are in Hong Kong where they are trying to arrest Baron Greenback.
Duckula, Igor and Nanny join the circus.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Count Duckula: The Vampire Strikes Back
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Duckula collects enough Crunchie Nut tokens to get a Space explorers helmet.
Danger Mouse and Penfold are golfing when they are called by Colonel K to meet with space alien J. J. Quark, who wants to make a treaty with them in North Africa.
Dr Quackbrain lures Duckula to his dream machine for his greatest experiment.
Greenback makes a device to control DM's car.
Greenback offers to team up with Danger Mouse in order to thwart an alien invasion. Professor Sqawkencluck outfits the Space Hopper with a secret weapon.
Duckula travels to the North Pole.
Historic buildings such as Tower of London, Eiffel Tower, Kremlin and the Empire State Building have disappeared.
Duckula and Goosewing discover their grandfathers' diaries, and history is sure to repeat itself!

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Toad Warriors
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: In the badlands of Car Land, Mario, Luigi, Princess Toadstool and Toad are riding in a brown convertible car, planning on rendezvousing with several Mushroom rebels.

Penfold has been littering their home with the crumbs of his aunt's cookies. Danger Mouse and Penfold go to the United States to stop Greenback who has stolen a bunch of landmarks from New York City including the Statue of Liberty.
London appears to be flooded in water, and its citizens have to crowd up in the top parts of its buildings.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Mario and Joliet
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: In the Land of Romance, Mario, Luigi, Toad and Princess Toadstool, who had been called to the Land of Romance by a friend of Princess Toadstool, are currently trapped in a rapidly crumbling building.
Duckula goes to stay at a worn out and run down hotel for the weekend.
Duckula, Igor and Nanny take an airplane to Nice.
Duckula goes to the Town Hall to get a grant for his crumbling castle.
Danger Mouse and Penfold travel to Scotland to keep Greenback from destroying the world with music from all the bagpipes in the world.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.st: This Babe Ruth "Babe" Is A Dude, Dude!
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Bill and Ted go in search of Babe Ruth so they can replace their coach's autographed baseball.  On their trip back in time, they stop to teach the rules of baseball to the Yankee and Confederate soldiers at Bull Run.

Colonel K thinks Danger Mouse has camouflaged himself and starts rambling. After Danger Mouse arrives to straighten up things, Danger Mouse and Penfold head to Canada to track down a Bigfoot that has been crushing the local villages and landscape.
Greenback kidnaps Penfold to lure Danger Mouse into a spaceship and send both of them to a planet ruled by old fashioned looking machines.
Duckula's new computer causes problems for TRASH and ends up landing the castle on the moon.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.st: One Sweet And Sour Chinese Adventure To Go
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Bill and Ted accidentally break Missy's brand new antique vase. The phone booth is set for ancient China to find a replacement.  After a brief stint as prisoners who are ordered to build a wall, they serve as unlikely deckhands for Marco Polo.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Count Duckula: The Lost City of Atlantis
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Count Duckula and co. are stuck on a tiny island.

Awkward.se.d: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.
Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.
Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.
Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.
Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
Awkward.se.st: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
Awkward.se.d: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?
Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.
Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
Awkward.se.d: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.
En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.
Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.
Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
Awkward.se.st: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
Awkward.se.d: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.
Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.
Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?
Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
Awkward.se.d: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.
Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.
Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
Awkward.se.d: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
Awkward.se.st: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
Awkward.se.d: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.

Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.
Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.
I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.
Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.
Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.
Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.
Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.
Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.
Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.
Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.
Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

BETThrowbacks.us.st: Why Don't We Just Roll... Reversal
BETThrowbacks.us.d: Jamie and Fancy learn about themselves during a disastrous role-playing game.
Lisa decides it's time to "dump" Terrence and forbids Ray from hanging out with him, while Roger tries to pick which twin to "woo."
When a high school football star needs a tutor, Tamera pretends to be Tia so she can teach him a special lesson in "chemistry"!
An embarrassing arrest from his college days comes back to haunt Ray, and Lisa turns an inheritance into a shopping spree

Jason decides to leave a wild Brittany with the ultimate babysitter... Tasha.
Malik tries to end things with Parker so he can live an honest life with Jenna, but things don't go exactly as planned.
When Tasha finds out her new man has a terminal illness, they spend his final days tackling their bucket lists.
After trying unsuccessfully to get pregnant, Melanie and Derwin visit a fertility specialist, but the visit to the fertility specialist reveals more than Melanie bargained for.
In the fifth season premiere, Melanie contends with Derwin's abortion accusation by leading him to believe he was the father of a child she terminated in college.
In the second half of the fifth season opener, Melanie reveals a huge confession to Derwin regarding the abortion that he assumed was of their child.
Melanie feels like something is missing in her life after Derwin goes back to Irv as his manager.
Melanie and Tasha's feud finds a public forum while preparing for the annual Sunbeams fashion show.
Jason's ego takes a hit when Chardonnay rejects his proposal about hooking up after their upcoming annulment.
Jamie, a talented performer, dreams of success while working at an aging Los Angeles hotel.

Jamie tries to impress Fancy by becoming a mentor to Nelson, an innocent-looking kid. However, Nelson starts stealing various things from the hotel and lets Jamie take the blame. Orlando Brown guest stars.

BETThrowbacks.us.st: Burned Twice By the Same Flame
BETThrowbacks.us.d: Jamie foolishly believes that his engaged ex-girlfriend is in town to see him, so he asks Fancy to pretend to be his girlfriend.
Jamie coaches Braxton on how to attract women--with unexpected results.

BETThrowbacks.us.st: We Finally Got A Piece Of The Pie
BETThrowbacks.us.d: Jamie and Junior decide to start a business selling Helen's sweet potato pies. However, just when the business is about to take off, Jamie eats all of the orders.

Braxton is embarrassed by his parents, who come to visit him and end up getting along better with Jamie than with their own son. Later, at a banquet in Braxton's honor, its members insult his parents.

Junior entrusts Helen's wedding ring to Jamie after deciding to have it reconditioned for their anniversary. Jamie shows the ring to Fancy and Braxton, but when Helen arrives, he slips it onto Fancy's finger to keep the surprise from being ruined.
At a Halloween masquerade party, Jamie mistakes Fancy for his date. Halloween episode

Jamie is torn between his opportunity to get his career off the ground and his loyalty to his uncle Junior when he catches an entertainment attorney, a friend of Junior's, trying to coerce Helen into an affair. Lou Myers guest stars.

A director convinces Helen to let him film a movie in her hotel. The director casts Jamie in the role of the bad guy who is always getting beaten up. Jamie and the rest of the hotel crew soon tire of the director's rude behavior.
Jamie suspects that one of their hotel guests is an infamous serial killer.
When a promotional scheme goes awry, Jamie and the others learn the meaning of giving thanks. Thanksgiving episode
Jamie gets jealous when Fancy's rich ex-boyfriend shows up at the hotel with a diamond ring and a proposal.
Jamie wakes up with a sexy woman--who is marrying someone else that day.
Jamie buys a fancy sports car from a disreputable character and regrets it.
A movie actress friend of Helen's comes on to Jamie while she is in town teaching an acting seminar. Janet Hubert-Whitten guest stars.
Jamie finds it hard to follow Junior and Helen's rule to have no wild parties when they leave to go on vacation, and the Westside Connection (Ice Cube, Mack10, and WC) comes to stay at the hotel.
Jamie may have to eat his words after he tells Fancy that he is a vegetarian and later is offered a job as spokesman for a hamburger restaurant.

BETThrowbacks.us.st: Step Up to Get Beat Down
BETThrowbacks.us.d: Jamie suspects that he is being blackmailed by a record company owner and decides to cause a little trouble of his own. Tony Cox guest stars.

Danny has to deal with how his friends and family feel about his wife.

BroadCity.se.d: Efter at have modtaget en stor regning for skadedyrsbekæmpelse holder Jaime og Ilana en fest for at dække omkostningerne. I mellemtiden har Abbi en mission om at møde nye mennesker.
Ilana finder sit nye kald, og Abbi tage forbi det mest frygtede sted i verden: motorkontoret.
Ilana bliver hyret som hårmodel, Abbis nye flamme fortæller hende, at hun ikke er moden nok.
Abbi og Ilana besøger 'Sleep No More' og Abbi vil finde det rigtige tidspunkt til at fortælle Ilana en livsforandrende nyhed.
Abbi, Ilana og Bevers sælger Abbis New York-ting; Abbi skaffer billetter til en Lil Wayne-koncert og pigerne tager på et 'trip.'
Broads siger farvel.

BroadCity.se.t: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
BroadCity.se.d: Ilana får nys om en hemmelig Lil Wayne-koncert. Sammen med Abbi buffler hun sig frem i New York. Pigerne lader intet forhindre dem i at skrabe nok penge sammen til billetterne. Selvom det bliver skræmmende, taber de aldrig målet af sigte.
Efter at have forsøgt at finde fyre på Facebook beslutter Abbi og Ilana sig for at prøve at finde fyre i 'virkeligheden'.
Ilana prøver at tjene lidt ekstra penge i 'temp game'. Abbi lover sin nabo at vente på hans pakke, men hun går glip af leverancen og må tage til verdens ende for at få fat i den.
Da Abbi får sprøjtet sin lejlighed mod skadedyr, og Ilana taber sine nøgler, tvinges pigerne til at bo på gaden - lige når Abbi har sin første kunstudstilling.
Pigerne må blive voksne! Abbi vil købe sin egen marihuana, som en voksen kvinde, mens Ilana skal lave skat alene. Og, pigerne er hamrende skæve.
Da Abbi indser, at hun er for sød, bliver hun straks mere bitchy. Ilana beslutter sig for at nå sit fulde potentiale. De går til en eksklusiv fest og møder nogle dejlige dj's. Nu kan intet gå galt.

Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.
Ilana leder febrilsk efter en gave i sidste øjeblik til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver at finde et klimaanlæg for at få det køligt i soveværelset.
Der dukker nye muligheder op, når Abbi endelig kan træne nogen på Soulstice og Ilana får succes som firmachef.

Abbi skal have sine visdomstænder trukket ud og Ilana ser det som sin pligt at passe hende til hun får det bedre - hvilket selvfølgelig indebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og et totalt mangel på tilsyn.
Abbi og Jeremy går på en date som slutter med en overraskelse. Ilana og hendes mor leder efter den perfekte håndtaske.
Pigerne leder efter den perfekte fest, hvilket afslører en underlig og surrealistisk side af Abbi, som bekræfter Ilanas værste anelser.
Slænget skal fejre, at Jaime er blevet amerikansk statsborger, men Bevers leder Abbi og Ilana på afveje ved at love dem gratis sprut. Imens må Lincoln og Jaime klare sig selv blandt alle advokaterne.
Abbi prøver at finde en forsvunden frakke, mens Ilana udforsker en ny romance - som føles besynderligt velbekendt.
Da pigerne fejrer Ilanas 23-års fødselsdag bliver de afbrudt af en bortløben teenager, der fører dem på en vildt jagt rundt i St. Mark's Place.
Abbi og Ilana får et tøjproblem på vej til en venindes udstilling og samtidig har de desperat brug for et offentligt toilet.
Abbi må lade, som om hun er Ilana for at tage hendes vagt på jobbet, mens Ilana tager til Long Island på grund af en meget vigtig lægeaftale.
Ilana får en ny mulighed på Deals, Deals, Deals, og Abbi prøver at holde sit konkurranceinstinkt i skak på Soulstice Games Day.
Efter at have modtaget en stor regning for skadedyrsbekæmpelse holder Jaime og Ilana en fest for at dække omkostningerne. I mellemtiden har Abbi en mission om at møde nye mennesker.
Ilana finder sit nye kald, og Abbi tage forbi det mest frygtede sted i verden: motorkontoret.
Abbi og Ilana drar til Philly for at besøge Abbis barndomshjem . Da Abbi indser, at hun begik en stor fejl i high school, tager hun og Ilana ud på en forsoningsmission.
Abbi og Ilana lægger deres lejligheder ud på B & B-NYC for at tjene lidt ekstra penge.
Ilanas forældre kommer til byen til deres 30-års jubilæum, men Abbi og Ilana synes, det er svært at fejre, når de begge har samlivsproblemer.
Abbi og Ilana skal ud at rejse, men det er sværere at komme i lufhavnen end forventet.

BroadCity.se.t: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
BroadCity.se.d: Abbi får menses under en flytur, så hun og Ilana går drastisk til værks for at finde en tampon.
På en forårsdag i 2011 mødes Abbi og Ilana for første gang.
Abbi vender tilbage til Soulstice, og det bliver interessant, da hun bliver tilbudt den træning, hun altid har drømt om. Ilana får et nyt job på en restaurant.
Iliana shopper vildt med sine drikkepenge fra servitricejobbet, og Abbi stråler i sit nye forhold. Senere den aften støder pigerne ind i en gammel ven til en fest.
Abbi og Ilana tager svampe og får et begivenhedsrigt trip.
Abbis mor kommer på besøg. Ilana skal forholde sig til den intense arbejdskultur på Sushi Mambeaux og sin sæsonbetingede affektive lidelse på samme tid.
Abbi føler sig gammel, da hun finder et gråt hår. Ilana går til en sexterapeut.
Abbi, Ilana, Eliot og Bobbi rejser til Florida for at rydde bedstemor Esthers lejlighed.
Abbi, Ilana, Jaime og Lincoln passer hus for Strands. Ilana og Lincoln definerer deres forhold, og Abbi har en Bumble-date med en mand fra sin fortid.

CarolineintheCity.se.d: When Caroline finally discovers that Richard is back in New York, she offers him his old position back and Richard must decide if he wants to be in Caroline's life again.
When Annie finds herself being audited by IRS agent Jimmy Callahan she misconstrues his friendly manner for amorous interest.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Guy Who Gets There Too Soon
CarolineintheCity.se.d: When Caroline's young boyfriend Joe declares his undying love for her, she realizes that she is not ready for the level of commitment that Joe arrived at so quickly.
Richard's dream of being a paid artist comes true when he is commissioned to paint a mural for New York City.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Nice Jewish Boy
CarolineintheCity.se.d: When gentile Del falls for Risa Glickman, who only dates Jewish men, he takes drastic measures to pretend that he is Jewish.
Caroline discovers that Richard's father is a former vaudeville comic, Ben Karinsky and tries to reunite him with a reluctant Richard.
When Caroline observes that her pet cat Salty is troubled, she consults her veterinarian boyfriend, Joe, who suggests taking Salty to an eccentric cat therapist.
When Annie's mother shows up on Annie's doorstep with suitcase in hand, Caroline  finds herself caught in the middle.
Another side of Caroline's artistic expression -- her dream of being a ballerina -- is revealed when she is locked in a laundromat overnight with a homeless man.
Caroline and Joe's romance takes a nosedive when his ex-girlfriend Lisa returns from her Greenpeace mission and seeks shelter at Joe's apartment.

When Annie's sister Donna visits New York in hopes of resurrecting her career, she finds the love letter Richard hid from Caroline and decides that setting the lyrics to music could be her next big hit, forcing Richard to feel slightly off-key.
Del brings one of Richard's paintings to a posh country club to impress a girl, but the best impresssion is made on a wealthy socialite, much to Richard's delight.
Caroline cheers Richard on when he gets the chance to win big money by making the half-court free-throw shot at a New York Knicks game.
Richard finds himself in a life-or-death predicament when Caroline aims to boost the value of his work by convincing an influential art columnist that Richard is a deceased artist.

Caroline feels that Annie consistently chooses the men in her life over their friendship and challenges Annie to take a girls-only trip, but chaos ensues when they take a trip together and both girls find romance at a local ski resort.
Caroline, who is trying to face single life bravely, tries her hand at an evening on the town alone, with a little coaching from Richard.
When Caroline supports Del in his efforts to expand business for her "Caroline in the City" cartoon strip and merchandise.
Caroline's naive, helpful nature comes out in full bloom when she starts catering to her new elderly neighbor, Miriam, but Annie thinks Caroline is being taken advantage of.
When Caroline discovers that only one newspaper in the country has not renewed her cartoon strip, she obsesses on the matter until finally convincing herself to face the editors in person.
Caroline has difficulty confronting her neglectful building superintendent, Mr. Tedescu about her faulty plumbing, so she hires a mediator to pressure Mr. Tedescu into taking care of her request.
Richard is stunned when his former love Julia informs him that she is about to be married.
In the ongoing charade of Caroline pretending that she and Richard are married.
A remorseful Caroline panics when she realizes that several hours have passed since she poured her heart out to Richard on his answering machine -- and she hasn't heard a response from him.

Caroline realizes that the constant aching in her neck could be related to the stress she feels over her unresolved feelings toward Richard, but she doesn't let it get in the way of helping Richard navigate through troubled waters with Julia.

Caroline feigns having read a writer’s novel to impress him, but their first date is a disaster as Caroline’s charade crumbles. Meanwhile, Richard jumps to Julia’s rescue when her waitress job at Remo’s leaves her customers hungry for attention.
When Caroline discovers that she’s been receiving free cable, her honesty with the cable company gets her into deep trouble with her not-so-truthful neighbors.
When Annie is visited by her old singing teacher, Miss McGowan, Caroline helps Annie pretend to still have her “Cats” role, an act that may have a surprise ending.
It’s a game of messy politics when Caroline will not endorse a local councilman, who is inspired by her comic strip, while Del conjures up a promotional campaign.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Used Car Salesman
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Discreetly planning to ease Caroline’s homesick holiday blues, Richard (Malcolm Gets) goes to great lengths to get a gift for Caroline that inspires suspicion in Julia (Sofia Milos) and sleuthing from Caroline and Annie.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Love That Dare Not Speak Its Name
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Informed by Annie (Amy Pietz) of Caroline’s (LeaThompson) unspoken love for him, Richard (Malcolm Gets) confronts Caroline, who tells him that it’s a thing of the past.
When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is tapped as a celebrity guest star for a quiz show, her jitters prompt Richard (Malcolm Gets) to help her study, much to Julia’s (Sofia Milos) chagrin.
Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to convince an insecure Del(Eric Lutes) that he has the potential to be a great parent after Del is shocked to discover that he is the father of a 10-year old girl.

When Julia (Sofia Milos) tells Caroline (Lea Thompson) that it’s not easy being on the outside of her close working relationship with Richard (Malcolm Gets), Caroline quickly, and mysteriously, learns what it’s like to walk a mile in Julia’s shoes.
As Caroline (Lea Thompson) struggles with commitment issues over Trevor, Richard(Malcolm Gets) inadvertently causes a rift between Caroline and her new beau.

When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is insulted by a local cabbie, Adamo, she takes her case to higher powers at the travel commission.  Meanwhile, Richard, frustrated by a “painter’s block,” becomes obsessed with computers when he joins a cyber cafe.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Visit From The Mom
CarolineintheCity.se.d: When Caroline’s (Lea Thompson)mother, Margaret Duffy (guest star Edie McClurg, “The Hogan Family”), visits Caroline for a mother-daughter People magazine shoot, tensions rise over unexpressed feelings.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline and the Marriage Counselor, Pt. 1
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Caroline (Lea Thompson) must hire a new cartoon colorist when Richard (Malcolm Gets) finally quits after he and Julia (Sofia Milos) move into their glamorous new home.

CheersPlusFrasier.us.d: Frasier and Niles are caught in the middle when Martin's girlfriend and Daphne can't stop bickering.
Frasier tries to console Niles after Maris serves him with divorce papers.
When Niles asks Frasier whether he and Maris belong together, Frasier goes out of his way to give his brother an honest, thoughtful response.
Frasier comes down with a case of the "bachelor blues" when he realizes that every single person he knows is dating someone -- except him.
Nobody believes Frasier when he claims to be dating a famous supermodel.
The sibling rivalry between Frasier and Niles reaches a fever pitch when they try and "top" each other's 65th birthday gift to their father, Martin.
Niles' Halloween costume party becomes a comedy of errors when he mistakenly thinks that Daphne is pregnant -- and Frasier's the father.
Frasier is stunned when he learns the true identity of the man who is the father of Roz's baby.
Niles' envy and a series of mishaps may prevent Frasier from attending the festivities honoring him for his 1,000th radio show.
To take Niles' mind off his marital problems, Frasier invites him on an Alaskan cruise -- but neglects to tell Niles he's also invited Maris as a "surprise."
Frasier falls for a high-powered lawyer, whose successful career and take-charge attitude turns Frasier into a "wimp."
When, Frasier gets "dumped" by his high-powered girlfriend Sam, he makes a fool of himself trying to win her back.
It's a Christmas to remember when Martin sings in a church pageant, Niles gets stuck in an elevator, and Frasier spills the beans about Roz's pregnancy to her unsuspecting mother.

CheersPlusFrasier.us.st: Where Every Bloke Knows Your Name
CheersPlusFrasier.us.d: Daphne's attempts to lift Frasier's spirits by taking him to her favorite British pub backfires when Frasier decides to become a regular at "her" hangout.

CheersPlusFrasier.us.st: Ain't Nobody's Business If I Do
CheersPlusFrasier.us.d: The discovery of an engagement ring hidden in their father's drawer leads Niles and Frasier to investigate Sherry's checkered past before Martin has a chance to "pop the question."
Fed up with his cutthroat agent Bebe, Frasier soon learns the high price of hiring a "nice" agent to represent him in contract negotiations.
Niles is shocked to discover that his trusted marriage counselor and Maris are having a torrid affair behind his back.
A weekend ski trip snowballs into a hotbed of romantic antics for Frasier, Niles and their friends.
An unexpected visit from Lilith stirs old passions in Frasier and new ones in Niles.
Sparks fly when a family wedding re-ignites a long-simmering feud between Frasier and his fiery Greek Aunt Zora.

The radio station hires a handsome new doctor to host a call-in medical show, but Frasier, nursing his male ego, is determined to find a flaw in his new colleague, who seems just a little "too perfect."
When Bulldog wrongfully takes credit for foiling a robbery and saving Roz's life, Frasier becomes determined to make Bulldog "come clean."
Frasier's torn between his "lust" for his latest conquest and the realization that they have nothing in common except great sex.
Niles gets Daphne to help him plan a phony dinner date with a neighbor so she won't realize how much he really cares for her.
Roz worries about the fate of her new baby when she discovers that the parents of her baby's father have two of the biggest noses she's ever seen.
Desperate to make a love connection, Frasier and Niles join forces to throw a singles party -- and end up vying for the affections of the same woman.
Frasier attempts to be in three places at once as he tries to keep his girlfriend, brother and dad happy.
When Frasier leads a protest demanding better treatment of radio station employees, the head honcho at the station's parent company fires them all.
When Frasier appears to be in denial over losing his job, Niles, Roz and Martin join forces to bring him back to reality.
Frasier dreads the idea of attending his high school reunion, which always seems to coincide with a downturn in his life.
Niles isn't too thrilled at the prospect of his father moving in – until he realizes that Daphne is part of the package.
Frasier and Niles will stop at nothing to get tickets to the hottest play in town.
Frasier suspects that his gorgeous new girlfriend is just using him to get free psychiatric advice.

ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Robbie and his friend Hank need money to go on dates, so they decide to start a business for home repairs and outdoor chores.
Tramp gets framed.
An unexpected visitor catches Steve by surprise.

Gloria has been reading books on women's lib and encourages Edith to try a little liberation. However, Mike won't take any of her ideas, which leads to huge fight in which Gloria demands that Mike recognize her as an equal partner in their marriage.

Archie is all set to go to the Mets game; however, Edith has different plans after she accepted an invitation to dinner with the Jeffersons. Archie discovers this and comes up with the excuse that Edith sprained her ankle, thus turns down the invitation.
In The Princess, Miss Simmons plays Lydia of Lichtenstein who visits Felix's studio for a portrait sitting and meets Oscar, who, unaware of her station, tries to date her.
Felix is given an opportunity to direct a razor commercial on television, provided that he gets Deacon Jones to appear in it.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The Murray Who Came To Dinner
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: When Murray's wife ejects him from their home, Felix invites him to share his and Oscar's apartment.
Sportscaster Howard Cosell, in a neat bit of type-casting, plays Howard Cosell, a famous sportscaster who becomes involved in a feud with Oscar Madison.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The Pen Is Mightier Than The Pencil
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Felix decides to become a writer and Oscar thinks he's wasting his time and money.
When Oscar's ulcer begins acting up, Felix decides an ocean voyage will do them both good.
Oscar tries to cover up his divorce from his visiting mother by moving Felix out and ex-wife Blanche.
Felix turns to Oscar for help after complaining he no longer can communicate with his daughter.
Rob recounts the wrath he encountered when he broke his engagement with his hometown sweetheart, Dorothy after he and Laura became engaged.
Rob finds himself in hot water after giving a television interview in which he unwittingly portrays his wife Laura as a nut.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: I Was a Teenage Head Writer
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Rob leaves the show after Mel rejects his script and is upset when Buddy and Sally don't join him.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: It May Look Like a Walnut
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Rob and Laura watch a scary movie only to find certain details of that movie coming true the following day.
Laura tries to break Rob of his expensive habit of picking up the check.
To his regret, Rob ignores Laura's warning to be careful on the slopes during his first skiing excursion.
The Petries hire a painter who ends up painting much more than just their living room.
Rob, Laura, and the office gang put together a variety show to help out an old friend.
Rob plans to make himself scarce when he hears French heartthrob and old acquaintance, Jacques Savon, is Alan's guest star.
Rob finds himself very out of place at a dinner party for celebrated literati.
Kate uses her charms to keep Homer Bedloe from catching the train to Pixley.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The President Who Came To Dinner
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: President of the railroad comes to visit the Shady Rest hotel with the intention to terminate the Cannonball's service.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: Is There A Doctor In The Roundhouse
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Norman Curtis breaks the Cannonball's throttle lever, threatening the success of the Shady Rest Hotel's annual jamboree.
Kate's intentions are mistaken when she tries to help Floyd Smoot regain his confience after being slighted by the woman he loves.
Kate is forced to peddle cologne when Uncle Joe buys a bunch of cases with the money meant for window screens.
Betty Jo must challenge the legendary Pixley Fats in the Annual Horeshoe Tournament.
Kate tries to teach Betty Jo how to make Hot Rhubarb after setting her up on a double date.
Bank robbers stay the night at Shady Rest hoping to intercept a bank shipment on the Cannonball.
Uncle Joe is pelted with eggs after his team, the Hooterville Hornets lose a game.
Kate hires Herby to work as an Assistant Manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position.

Hedy Lamarr designs the first modern airplane wing, Eartha Kitt's activism provokes the ire of Lady Bird Johnson, and Alexis Pulaski's poodle becomes a huge star.
Forest service ranger Ed Pulaski saves 40 men from a forest fire, and Ted Patrick rescues teenagers from the psychological grip of the Children of God cult.
Martha Mitchell leaks the Watergate scandal to the press before Deep Throat does, and the Citizens' Commission to Investigate the FBI stages an epic break-in.

ComedyCentralPlutoTV.us.st: Chelsea Peretti, Derek Waters & Aubrey Plaza

ComedyCentralPlutoTV.us.st: Nikki Glaser, Jimmy Kimmel & Tracy Morgan
ComedyCentralPlutoTV.us.d: Landalious pitches his own wine brand, Elmer tries to find his missing gym clothes, and Bobby tries to leverage his Yelp notoriety to get special treatment at a restaurant.

ComedyCentralPlutoTV.us.st: Tiffany Haddish, Desus & Mero & Jimmy Kimmel
ComedyCentralPlutoTV.us.d: A woman hatches a scheme to get space from a coworker, Elmer wants his late wife's obituary to help him find love, and a cornhole enthusiast explains how the game has changed his life.

ComedyCentralPlutoTV.us.st: Adam Carolla, Kathy Griffin & Kyle Dunnigan
ComedyCentralPlutoTV.us.d: A concerned Sunday school teacher calls a bookstore to help them find salvation, Craig looks for professionals to keep him safe from his mother, and a woman wants a lesbian-friendly bird.
Nathan places a controversial ad in a pet cemetery, takes tips from a focus group in order to become more likable and devises a method to clean a house in six minutes flat.
Nathan comes up with a way to sell alcohol to minors, helps an exterminator land a hotel contract and uses birds to draw customers to a car wash.
Nathan makes use of parody law to open up a coffee shop nearly identical to Starbucks in its branding and appearance.
Nathan comes up with a way to get a failing taxi company some much-needed press and implements a risky new line-cutting policy at a hot dog stand.
Nathan markets an unappealing children's toy, devises a way to shame people who share their movie snacks and pitches a reality show starring Simon the security guard.
Nathan tries to leverage Best Buy's price-matching policy by advertising a deal on TVs that's too good to be true.
Nathan devises a way to provide a moving company with free labor.
Nathan recruits child athletes for endorsement deals and finds a way to put drunk people's clumsiness to good use.
Nathan works with the owner of a bar to turn her business into an immersive theater experience.
Nathan makes it easier for parents to have sex in a hotel room and finds a way for a travel agent to better serve her aging customers.
Episode 9 includes Walkathon, Temporary Insanity, Tainted Meat, Dream On, and Beaverly Buttbillies, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.

Beavis & Butthead features two lunkheaded teenagers who dress in heavy-metal T-shirts, love stuff that is "cool," hate stuff that "sucks," and spend most of their time sitting on a couch making fun of music videos.
Episode 10 includes Babysitting, Buttniks, and Bungholio: Lord of the Harvest.
Episode 2 includes Party, What's the Deal, Wet Behind the Rears, and Animation Sucks.
Episode 3 includes Candy Sale, Here Comes the Bride's Butt, Pregnant Pause, and Oil Change.
Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.
The deputies vow to avenge Sheriff Chechekevitch's death, and Wiegel studies with Lamaze instructor Guy Gerricault.
The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

ComedyCentralRoast.se.t: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Day 3
ComedyCentralRoast.se.d: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er Jimmy Kimmel og Seth Rogen.

ComedyCentralRoast.se.d: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.
Roastmester general Jeff Ross taler med Black Lives Matter-aktivister, kører en øjenåbnende tur med politiet og roaster folk fra Boston Politi.
I hver udgave af "The Roast of" bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Den aggressivt venlige skuespiller fra "Hænderne Fulde" og "Sjov og spas".

ComedyCentralRoast.se.t: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Day 1
ComedyCentralRoast.se.d: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er David Spade og Kevin Hart.

I dette program, der er delvis stand-up og delvis dokumenter, gransker og dissekerer Jeff Ross USA'simmigrationsdebat.

Milliardæren Donald Trump bliver heglet igennem på Comedy Central af Jeffrey Ross, Seth MacFarlane, Gilbert Gottfried, Whitney Cummings, Snoop Dogg, Larry King, Marlee Matlin, Mike 'The Situation' Sorrentino, Lisa Lampanelli og Anthony Jeselnic.
